verdict.rationale: Gladia documents a live STT quickstart. An init call returns a connectable session URL and id that clients can use without exposing credentials, the session supports reconnection without losing context, and results arrive as provisional partial and final transcripts. The docs also cover live-specific configuration such as silence thresholds and maximum utterance duration, and the default model supports live use. Missing for 10: the WebSocket protocol, audio encoding and message schema are not named explicitly in the excerpts, there are no latency figures, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time performance.
